## Hypothesis

H1: Points allocated to a partner's physical attractiveness differ by sex at birth.

H2: Confidence in finding a new partner is associated with relationship commitment.

```{r load package}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1data <-read.csv("data/processed_data/221A_h1.csv")
h2data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/221A_h2.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable
h1data$cot_politics <- factor(h1data$cot_politics,
                           levels = c("Far Left","Center Left","Center","Center Right","Far Right"))
#why is the above line deleting everything but center

```

## H1 - Box Plot

```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.
h1Box <- ggplot(data=h1data,
                aes(x=cot_politics, y=viewtotal,
                    fill=cot_politics))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x="Political Alignment",
       y="Level of Traditional Gender Views",
       title="graph")+
  theme_gray(base_size = 10)
h1Box


```

## H1 - Violin Plot (with Box Plot)

```{r H1Violin}
#Violin Plot
#Wider sections show where responses are more concentrated within each group.
#The shape depends on smoothing; integer scores can create bumps.
h1Viol <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=Sex_birth, y=preference_imp_physat,
                    fill=Sex_birth))+
  labs(x="Sex assigned at birth",
       y="Points allocated to partner physical attractiveness",
       title="Points allocated to physical attractiveness by sex")+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)+
  geom_violin()+
  geom_boxplot(width=.1)
h1Viol

```
